#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — one-way (A2) host->workspace mirror of the hermes context.
# rsync primary, cp fallback; stage -> verify -> touch DST (A11/A13); refusals cite A-numbers only (A19).
set -euo pipefail

die() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }

MODE="sync"
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) MODE="dry" ;;
    --verify) MODE="verify" ;;
    *) die "usage: sync-hermes-context.sh [--dry-run|--verify]" ;;
  esac
done

# --- A23: unset -> mandated production defaults; set-but-empty -> refuse ---
if [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC+x}" ]; then
  SRC="/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context"
elif [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC}" ]; then
  die "A23: HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC is set but empty"
else
  SRC="${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC}"
fi
if [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST+x}" ]; then
  DST="/workspace/hermes-context"
elif [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST}" ]; then
  die "A23: HERMES_CONTEXT_DST is set but empty"
else
  DST="${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST}"
fi

# canonicalize trailing slashes once; all later mutations use canonical paths
while [ "${SRC%/}" != "${SRC}" ]; do SRC="${SRC%/}"; done

# hermes-context sync

One-way (A2) host -> workspace mirror of the hermes context. The destination is
brought to an exact recursive mirror of the source (contents + structure +
symlinks; not metadata/timestamps/hardlinks — A9 class). No writeback ever
happens from workspace to host.

## Install

```sh
install -m 0755 sync-hermes-context.sh ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
cp hermes-context.service hermes-context.timer ~/.config/systemd/user/
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer
```

The service unit runs `%h/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh` (Type=oneshot).
The timer fires it on `OnCalendar=*-*-* 00/6:00:00` (every 6 hours,
`Persistent=true`, `Unit=hermes-context.service`) and is installed under
`WantedBy=default.target`. systemd is optional; the script is standalone and
needs no root.

## Environment overrides

- `HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC` — source dir (unset -> `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context`)
- `HERMES_CONTEXT_DST` — destination dir (unset -> `/workspace/hermes-context`)

Unset variables take the mandated production defaults; a variable that is set
but empty is refused (A23). Example:

```sh
HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC=/data/src HERMES_CONTEXT_DST=/data/dst \
  ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
```

Optional log placement: `HERMES_CTX_LOG` (log file path, default
`~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log`) or `LOG_DIR` (directory, log written as
`$LOG_DIR/sync.log`). The log file's parent and the entrypoint directory are
owned paths; a DST overlapping them is refused (A14/A15).

## --dry-run test procedure

```sh
~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run
```

Prints `dry-run: sync=N delete=M` and performs zero writes of any kind — no
stage dir, no log line, and an absent destination stays absent (A6/A16).
`--verify` is read-only: it fails when DST is absent or not an exact mirror.

## Sync strategy

- Primary: `rsync -a --delete` (exact recursive mirror, stale subtrees deleted,
  file<->dir type changes reconciled, DST-internal symlinks replaced by real
  files without touching link targets outside DST).
- Fallback (rsync absent): `cp -a` plus a recursive reconcile that deletes
  entries absent from SRC and copies missing/differing entries. Both paths end
  in the same state: DST == SRC recursively.
- Every run stages to a mktemp dir, verifies the stage against SRC (A13), and
  only then touches DST, followed by a final A9 verification (mismatch exits
  nonzero, never warn-and-exit-0).

- Adversarial environment combinations beyond the A14/A15 owned-path guard are
  out of scope (+open, A10).

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — one-way host->workspace mirror (A2), rsync primary.
set -euo pipefail

die() { printf '%s\n' "$1" >&2; exit 1; }

MODE="sync"
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run) MODE="dry" ;;
    --verify) MODE="verify" ;;
    *) die "usage: sync-hermes-context.sh [--dry-run|--verify]" ;;
  esac
done

# --- A23: unset -> mandated production defaults; set-but-empty -> refuse ---
if [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC+x}" ]; then
  SRC="/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context"
elif [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC}" ]; then
  die "A23: HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC is set but empty"
else
  SRC="${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC}"
fi
if [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST+x}" ]; then
  DST="/workspace/hermes-context"
elif [ -z "${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST}" ]; then
  die "A23: HERMES_CONTEXT_DST is set but empty"
else
  DST="${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST}"
fi

# canonicalize trailing slashes once (all mutations use canonical paths)
while [ "${SRC%/}" != "${SRC}" ]; do SRC="${SRC%/}"; done
while [ "${DST%/}" != "${DST}" ]; do DST="${DST%/}"; done

# --- A18 degenerate paths ---
if [ -z "${SRC}" ] || [ "${SRC}" = "." ] || [ "${SRC}" = "/" ]; then die "A18: degenerate HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC='${SRC}'"; fi
if [ -z "${DST}" ] || [ "${DST}" = "." ] || [ "${DST}" = "/" ]; then die "A18: degenerate HERMES_CONTEXT_DST='${DST}'"; fi

is_within() { # inside($2, $1): 0 if $2 == $1 or $2 under $1 (component-boundary)
  if [ "$2" = "$1" ]; then return 0; fi
  case "$2" in "$1"/*) return 0 ;; esac
  return 1
}

RS="$(realpath -m -- "${SRC}")"
RD="$(realpath -m -- "${DST}")"

# --- A12 identity / ancestor / descendant (realpath-based) ---
if [ "${RS}" = "${RD}" ]; then die "A12: SRC and DST resolve to the same path (${RS})"; fi
if is_within "${RD}" "${RS}"; then die "A12: DST is an ancestor of SRC (${RD} contains ${RS})"; fi
if is_within "${RS}" "${RD}"; then die "A12: DST resolves inside SRC (${RD} under ${RS})"; fi

# --- A22: DST itself is a symlink -> refuse, never replace ---
if [ -L "${DST}" ]; then die "A22: DST is a symlink (${DST} -> $(readlink -- "${DST}")); refusing to replace a user-placed symlink"; fi

# --- log target + owned paths (A8/A14/A15) ---
if [ -z "${HERMES_CTX_LOG+x}" ]; then
  LOGF="${HOME}/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log"
elif [ -z "${HERMES_CTX_LOG}" ]; then
  die "A23: HERMES_CTX_LOG is set but empty"
else
  LOGF="${HERMES_CTX_LOG}"
fi
LOG_DIR_OWNED=""
if [ -z "${LOG_DIR+x}" ]; then
  :
elif [ -z "${LOG_DIR}" ]; then
  die "A23: LOG_DIR is set but empty"
else
  LOGF="${LOG_DIR}/sync.log"
  LOG_DIR_OWNED="${LOG_DIR}"
fi

ENTRYPOINT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"

declare -a OWNED=()
OWNED+=("$(realpath -m -- "$(dirname -- "${LOGF}")")")
OWNED+=("${ENTRYPOINT_DIR}")
if [ -n "${LOG_DIR_OWNED}" ]; then
  OWNED+=("$(realpath -m -- "${LOG_DIR_OWNED}")")
  OWNED+=("$(realpath -m -- "$(dirname -- "${LOG_DIR_OWNED}")")")
fi

# --- A14/A15: DST must not overlap any owned concrete path ---
for o in "${OWNED[@]}"; do
  if is_within "${o}" "${RD}" || is_within "${RD}" "${o}"; then
    die "A14/A15: DST (${RD}) overlaps owned path (${o})"
  fi
done
LOGF_REAL="$(realpath -m -- "${LOGF}")"
if is_within "${RD}" "${LOGF_REAL}"; then die "A14/A15: log file (${LOGF_REAL}) is inside DST"; fi

# --- A9-class compare: contents + structure + symlinks; never dereferences ---
trees_equal() {
  local s="$1" d="$2" out p rel dd
  if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    out="$(rsync -rlcn --itemize-changes --delete -- "${s}/" "${d}/")" || return 1
    if [ -n "${out}" ]; then return 1; fi
  fi
  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
    rel="${p#"$s"}"
    dd="${d}${rel}"
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
      if [ ! -L "$dd" ]; then return 1; fi
      if [ "$(readlink -- "$p")" != "$(readlink -- "$dd")" ]; then return 1; fi
    elif [ -d "$p" ]; then
      if { [ -d "$dd" ] && [ ! -L "$dd" ]; }; then :; else return 1; fi
    elif [ -f "$p" ]; then
      if [ ! -f "$dd" ] || [ -L "$dd" ]; then return 1; fi
      cmp -s -- "$p" "$dd" || return 1
    else
      if [ ! -e "$dd" ] && [ ! -L "$dd" ]; then return 1; fi
    fi
  done < <(find "$s" -mindepth 0 -print0)
  while IFS= read -r -d '' p; do
    rel="${p#"$d"}"
    if [ ! -e "$s$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$s$rel" ]; then return 1; fi
  done < <(find "$d" -mindepth 1 -print0 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}
